title: Provider-neutral Task and Follow-up Agent can create only a matched ordinary task

given.provider: one explicit test-only task_follow_up fake/spy executor; production remains unbound and fail closed
given.context: strict PostgreSQL task, outcome, and evidence records only
given.run_identity: one TaskFollowUp command run_id with its canonical command fingerprint

when.success_flow: typed model proposal passes the post-model current guard, commits one runtime envelope_handed_off disposition, becomes one pending task_request envelope, and receives the matching project classification
when.denial_flow: the same stage instead observes archive or revoke and commits publication_denied before any envelope or classification

then.same_run_retry: cannot allocate another message; an identical denied retry returns the stored denial, conflicting input returns TASK_FOLLOW_UP_RUN_CONFLICT, and committed handoff resolves through the strict task-local incomplete|not_taskable|denied|duplicate|blocked result matrix with zero executor/writer calls
then.consumed_commitment: the classified disposition stores one PostgreSQL write-once expected Task-create fingerprint; coordinated Task/classification plus both-digest replacement is rejected and rolled back, Task-only corruption replay fails closed, denied stores null, and legacy consumed null is never backfilled
then.restore_and_concurrency: restore cannot make the denied run operative; lock_order_consumed_success_v1 proves task_created then zero-call ALREADY_CONSUMED retry; deterministic barriers fix eligible-first as RUN_CREATED then LOCAL_DUPLICATE, denied-first as the same stored RUN_DENIED for both, late-denial-first as LOCAL_INCOMPLETE then RUN_CREATED, and classified-writer-first as RUN_CREATED then LOCAL_DUPLICATE; every success order ends handedoff plus consumed, every denial-first order ends denial only, and reevaluation requires a new command/run/message
